path.name: Thunderhide
path.description: Akshan storm runner who uses Rage to dominate space.

design.name: Thunderhide
design.identity: Akshan storm runner who uses Rage to dominate space.
features: Choose Thunder or Lightning. While Raging gain Resistance to the chosen type. Once on each of your turns when a Might-based melee attack hits during Rage, deal chosen-type damage equal to your Rage Damage bonus. As a Bonus Action spend one Stormhide use to leap 15 feet; movement provokes normally.

Gain permanent Resistance to your chosen type. When a creature hits you with a melee attack while you Rage, you may use your Reaction to deal chosen-type damage equal to your Resolve modifier (minimum one) to it.

When you use the Stormhide leap, each creature of your choice within 5 feet of your landing space makes a Might save (DC 8 + Training Bonus + Might) or falls Prone. You must land on a supporting surface.

Once per Rage as a Bonus Action spend one Stormhide use to emit a 10-foot Emanation until your next turn. Enemies that start a turn there make a Resolve save against your Stormhide DC, taking 3d6 chosen-type damage on failure or half on success.

features.completionRules: Leap is special movement to a visible unoccupied supporting space and cannot cross solid barriers. Leaping need not occur during Rage, but damage/landing riders require Rage. Weather the Blow resolves after damage while conscious and seeing the attacker. Walking Storm is once per Rage instance, costs one Stormhide use and uses DC 8+TB+Might modifier.
